card: This pull request replaces the Boost.Test framework across all unit tests with an in-tree test runner in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} featuring expression decomposition. Today, Boost.Test imposes external dependency maintenance overhead, requires platform workarounds in Guix and depends, and provides fragmented assertion macros that frequently hide operand values upon test failures. Removing Boost.Test has been an ongoing repository objective since #8670 and #34666. Most of the 168 changed files are mechanical scripted include updates, with backward-compatible BOOST_* shims retained to prevent conflict with open PRs.
changed_since_previous: Added commits to resolve a GCC 12 uninitialized warning in spend_tests.cpp, enforce stringify implementations or explicit CHECK_NO_DISPLAY exemptions, and refine expression decomposition operator wrapping.

enables: Migrating test suites from legacy BOOST_* macros to new CHECK/REQUIRE assertions once merge conflicts subside.

evidence: Addresses long-standing repository goals and discussions to remove or replace the Boost unit test runner dating back to #8670 and #34666.
Eliminates dependency workarounds for Boost.Test quirks, such as the signal stack issue referenced in #36045 and unused workarounds in Guix.
problem: Boost.Test adds external dependency baggage and required platform workarounds in depends and Guix. Additionally, its assertion macros (BOOST_CHECK, BOOST_CHECK_EQUAL, BOOST_TEST) have fragmented behavior, often hiding operand values on failure or failing to compile when evaluating custom Bitcoin Core types without custom stream overloads.

risk.why: Flaws in the custom assertion decomposition or test runner could cause unit tests to report false positives, false negatives, or fail to compile across supported toolchains.

scope_notes: The vast majority of the 168 touched files are mechanical one-line include substitutions performed via scripted diff. Substantive implementation details are localized to src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}, src/test/util/common.{h,cpp}, and build configuration files.
summary: Replaces Boost.Test with an in-tree test framework implemented in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} that uses expression decomposition to display operand values on failure. Retains backward-compatible BOOST_* macro shims to avoid rewriting existing test bodies while migrating include headers across all test suites via scripted diff. Drops Boost.Test dependencies and platform workarounds from CMake, depends, vcpkg, and Guix.
